name: loinc
label: HL7 LOINC (Schema)
description: Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes — 100,000+ lab & clinical observation codes. Free download after registration at loinc.org. Load data via: flask forge templates install-data loinc

table_notes.loinc_code: Master table of all LOINC codes with their six-part naming axes, status, and ranking for the most common tests.
table_notes.loinc_hierarchy: Navigable multi-part classification tree for LOINC codes stored as ltree paths; leaves link back to loinc_code.
table_notes.loinc_answer_list: Permitted answer values (HL7 answer lists) for coded LOINC observations, one row per valid answer option.
table_notes.loinc_linguistic_variant: Official multilingual translations of LOINC long common names, one row per code per language.

loinc_code.name: component
loinc_code.description: What is measured (axis 1 of 6): analyte, organism, or observation substance

loinc_code.name: property
loinc_code.description: Characteristic of what is measured (axis 2): e.g. MCnc=mass concentration, ACnc=arbitrary concentration

loinc_code.name: system
loinc_code.description: Specimen or biological system where observation is made (axis 4): e.g. Ser, Urine, CSF

loinc_code.name: scale_typ
loinc_code.description: Scale of measurement (axis 5): Qn=quantitative, Ord=ordinal, Nom=nominal, Nar=narrative

loinc_code.name: method_typ
loinc_code.description: Optional measurement method (axis 6): e.g. Microscopy, Immune, Probe.amp.tar

loinc_code.name: class
loinc_code.description: LOINC panel/category grouping (e.g. CHEM, HEM/BC, MICRO, RAD)

loinc_code.name: long_common_name
loinc_code.description: Full human-readable name combining all six naming axes

loinc_code.name: short_name
loinc_code.description: Abbreviated display name suitable for column headers and constrained UIs

loinc_code.name: status
loinc_code.description: Publication lifecycle status: ACTIVE, TRIAL, DISCOURAGED, or DEPRECATED

loinc_code.name: order_obs
loinc_code.description: Usage context: Order=orderable test, Observation=result only, Both=either

loinc_code.name: common_test_rank
loinc_code.description: Rank among most frequently ordered tests (lower = more common; NULL if not ranked)

loinc_code.name: example_ucum_units
loinc_code.description: Typical UCUM unit for quantitative results (e.g. g/dL, mmol/L, %)

loinc_code.name: definition_description
loinc_code.description: Narrative definition clarifying the clinical intent and boundaries of this observation

loinc_code.name: consumer_name
loinc_code.description: Plain-language name intended for patient-facing applications

loinc_code.name: search_vector
loinc_code.description: PostgreSQL full-text search vector over loinc_num, long_common_name, and component

loinc_hierarchy.name: path
loinc_hierarchy.description: Materialized ltree path encoding position in the LOINC classification tree

loinc_hierarchy.name: code
loinc_hierarchy.description: LOINC panel/multipart/part code at this node (may differ from loinc_num on leaf)

loinc_hierarchy.name: depth_level
loinc_hierarchy.description: Depth of this node in the hierarchy tree (root = 0)

loinc_hierarchy.name: code_text
loinc_hierarchy.description: Display label for this hierarchy node

loinc_hierarchy.name: is_leaf
loinc_hierarchy.description: True if this node is a leaf (directly maps to a loinc_code row)

loinc_hierarchy.name: loinc_num
loinc_hierarchy.description: FK to loinc_code; populated only for leaf nodes representing a single LOINC observation

loinc_answer_list.name: answer_list_id
loinc_answer_list.description: LOINC answer list identifier (LL prefix, e.g. LL539-8); shared across codes using the same list

loinc_answer_list.name: answer_string_id
loinc_answer_list.description: Unique LOINC identifier for this individual answer concept within the list

loinc_answer_list.name: answer_code
loinc_answer_list.description: External coding system code for this answer (SNOMED CT, HL7, or local code)

loinc_answer_list.name: display_text
loinc_answer_list.description: Human-readable label for this answer option as shown in forms or result reports

loinc_answer_list.name: answer_rank
loinc_answer_list.description: Display order of this answer within its answer list (ascending)

loinc_answer_list.name: loinc_num
loinc_answer_list.description: FK to loinc_code; links this answer list membership to a specific coded LOINC observation

loinc_linguistic_variant.name: loinc_num
loinc_linguistic_variant.description: FK to loinc_code identifying the observation being translated

loinc_linguistic_variant.name: lang_code
loinc_linguistic_variant.description: ISO 639-1 or BCP-47 language tag (e.g. de-AT, fr-FR, zh-CN)

loinc_linguistic_variant.name: long_common_name
loinc_linguistic_variant.description: Official LOINC long common name translated into the target language

loinc_linguistic_variant.name: linguistic_rank
loinc_linguistic_variant.description: Preference rank when multiple translations exist for the same code and language (1 = preferred)

short_description: Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes — 100,000+ lab & clinical observation codes. Free download after registration at loinc.org. Load data via: flask forge templates install-data loinc
long_description: LOINC (Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes) provides 100,000+ universal codes for laboratory and clinical observations — from blood glucose measurements to radiology reports. The schema includes the main code table, hierarchical classification tree, multilingual variants, and answer list definitions for coded observations. Data download is free after registration at loinc.org.
when_to_use: Use alongside FHIR R4 for any lab, pathology, or clinical measurement system. Required by CMS in the US for electronic lab reporting. Essential when storing structured clinical results that must be understood by multiple systems without proprietary code translation.
